narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a personal interview with baseball player Chen Chieh-hsien one year after the Premier12 tournament. The intent is to highlight his humility and his perspective on fame, particularly his insistence that his success is a result of collective team effort rather than individual heroism.
